name: Luke Cage

abilityDetails.Exhaustion: Rakibin kritik vuruş gücünü ve tetiklenme oranını azaltır.
abilityDetails.Sunder: Kritik Direncini sıfıra indirir ve artmasını engeller.
abilityDetails.Debilitate: Debilitate dışında yeni uygulanan debuff'ların süresini uzatır.
abilityDetails.Concussion: Etkilenen şampiyonların yetenek doğruluğunu belirtilen güçte azaltır.
abilityDetails.Trauma: Alınan vuruşlar, yakın zamanda verilen hasarın bir kısmını ek fiziksel hasar patlaması olarak verdirir.

howToPlay: Luke Cage için oynanış rehberi: Özel saldırılarını kullanarak rakiplerini alt edin. Komboları düzgün zamanlayarak siper alın.
bestUse: Bu şampiyon genel maceralarda ve Science sınıfı avantajı olan yollarda en iyi performansı gösterir.
signatureAbility:
Tough It Out
Bulletproof skin grants Luke Cage an Indestructible Passive for [1.5 - 4] seconds when struck.
After it expires, this ability goes on cooldown for [60 - 35] seconds. This cooldown is paused while the Opponent is Stunned.
While his Indestructible is not on cooldown, Luke gains [305.56 - 1,833.33] Block Proficiency.

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: Bulletproof and near impenetrable skin provides Immunity to Bleed effects and reduces the damage of incoming non-contact Physical hits by 30%.
Luke Cage gains [3,021.3] Attack Rating for each unique Debuff on the Opponent.
Luke Cage gains [1,510.65] Attack Rating for each non-unique Debuff on the Opponent.
Luke's personal Trauma and Exhaustion Debuffs are paused during the Opponent's Special Attacks.

abilitySections.title: Exhaustion
content: Luke's powerful blows wear down his Opponents. Light Attacks have an 80% chance to inflict an Exhaustion Debuff, reducing Critical Damage Rating by -[115.9] for 12 seconds. Chance to apply is reduced by 5% flat per stack on the Opponent. Max stacks: 20.
When struck by a Special Attack 3, inflict 2 of these Exhaustion Debuffs.
The Opponent's Ability Power Rate is reduced by 25% for each Exhaustion Debuff on them, to a maximum of 6.
While the Opponent is suffering from at least 6 Exhaustion Debuffs, they suffer an indefinite Sunder Debuff, setting Critical Resistance to 0.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: Inflict a non-stacking 35% potency Debilitate Debuff for 12 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attacks
content: Exhaustion and Trauma Debuffs on the Opponent are paused during Luke's Special Attacks, and for 3 seconds afterwards per Bar of Power spent, paused during the Opponent's Special Attacks.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: Each hit deals a burst of [1,510.65] Physical Damage.

If a personal Concussion is active, the final hit inflicts a Stun Debuff for 2.5 seconds. Each time this Stun is inflicted, its duration is reduced by 50% until the next time Luke inflicts a Concussion.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: Consume up to 5 personal Exhaustion Debuffs to inflict a Concussion Debuff for 25 seconds, reducing Ability Accuracy by 15% per Debuff consumed.
Against Mystic Opponents, apply an additional Concussion Debuff if 5 Exhaustions were consumed.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Inflict a non-stacking Trauma Debuff for 30 seconds, causing all hits to deal an additional 20% of the damage recently dealt as a burst of Physical Damage.
Inflict 4 Exhaustion Debuffs, each reducing Critical Damage Rating by [126.57] for 30 seconds. Max Stacks: 4.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Tough It Out
content: Bulletproof skin grants Luke Cage an Indestructible Passive for [1.5 - 4] seconds when struck.
After it expires, this ability goes on cooldown for [60 - 35] seconds. This cooldown is paused while the Opponent is Stunned.
While his Indestructible is not on cooldown, Luke gains [305.56 - 1,833.33] Block Proficiency.
